annotations.text: Explore is live — tap a size, colour or pattern and the count and grid update. The other five phone screens are static mockups.
Specimen art is PLACEHOLDER: abstract wing forms standing in for photographs. Real imagery arrives with the content pilot.
Every control is 48px or taller and every primary action 56px — the field rule, since one hand is holding binoculars.
Dawn holds every hue between 5 and 25 degrees, so no pixel emits blue-white and night vision survives a 4am start.
German stress test. Chips never break mid-word — the row rewraps around them, and the pack title ellipsises. 'Augenflecken' and 'Alle zurücksetzen' are the strings that force it.
